name: Matchory
description:
Matchory brings supplier discovery and market intelligence into Claude. Ask for suppliers by capability, region, or material and get real, sourced company records from Matchory's index of millions of verified supplier profiles — never invented, always traceable to a source.
Built for procurement leaders, category managers, and sourcing teams who need trustworthy answers fast, the Matchory MCP lets you:
 - Discover suppliers by product, service, material, technology, industry, role, and country.
 - Find similar companies to one you already know, using AI similarity search.
 - Ground answers in a supplier's own website — capabilities, certifications, products, and contacts, quoted from the source.
 - See market intelligence — which countries produce a part, their share of supply, and financial, geopolitical, and logistics risk.
 - Extract sourcing requirements from a prompt or an uploaded document.
 - Organize your work into sourcing projects and share them with colleagues.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Matchory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Matchory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://discovery.matchory.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Matchory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matchory lists 15 MCP tools, including add-project-collaborator, create-project, delete-project, extract-search-requirements, find-similar-companies, get-market-overview, get-project, list-attachments, list-project-collaborators, list-projects, list-search-extractions, and search-suppliers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Matchory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Matchory in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Matchory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Matchory is developed by Matchory GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
